key.name: dim-range
key.summary: Share of the brightness slider that dims the picture
key.description: Below this slider position the backlight stays at its minimum and the picture is dimmed. Above it the slider drives the backlight over its full range.

key.name: darkest-level
key.summary: Picture level at the very bottom of the slider
key.description: 1.0 is the undimmed picture. The lower limit keeps the screen readable enough to find the slider again.
